from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class MonetaryItem(BaseModel):
    """A monetary figure mentioned in the document."""
    amount: str = Field(description="The amount as written (e.g. '100949.84 元')")
    purpose: str = Field(description="What the amount refers to (e.g. 'compensation', 'court fee')")
    payer: str | None = Field(description="Who is responsible for payment, if stated")

class DocumentFacts(BaseModel):
    """Extracted facts from a single judicial document."""
    document_label: str | None = Field(description="Identifier for the document (e.g. '《判决文书 1》')")
    case_numbers: list[str] = Field(description="All case numbers mentioned in the document")
    appellant_names: list[str] = Field(description="Names of appellants or petitioners")
    appellee_names: list[str] = Field(description="Names of appellees or defendants")
    ruling_keywords: list[str] = Field(description="Key phrases describing the outcome (e.g. '驳回上诉', '撤销裁定', '维持原判')")
    monetary_items: list[MonetaryItem] = Field(description="All monetary figures with context")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentFacts] = Field(description="Extracted facts from all provided documents")
